notes.title: Devlog #4 - Early Access improvements & Release Date
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We're excited to announce that Bullet Noir will leave Early Access with the release of version 1.0 on Wednesday, [b][u]September 10, 2025![/u][/b][/p][p]In our brand-new fourth devlog, we detail the improvements and additions made in preparation for this milestone and since the Early Access launch, including the introduction of a brand-new Chapter 5, an enhanced arcade mode and speedrun options for all four characters, as well as technical upgrades, overhauled graphics and cinematics, a refined UI, and additional languages.[/p][p][/p][h3]Check it out:[/h3][previewyoutube="6F88OwY5xyk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Play the Demo and buy Bullet Noir to get ready for 1.0![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204960/Bullet_Noir/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Update 6
notes.notes: [h3]Our final Early Access update, arriving before the 1.0 launch, is packed with new content and polish![/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]Revenge now speaks your language! [/p][p]The 1.0 launch is right around the corner. [/p][p]Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204960/Bullet_Noir/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: Early Access Update #5 – v0.9.1 Is Live
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Our fifth major Early Access update is here, and it’s all about speed, precision, and fresh challenges.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🕒 [b]New Mode: Speedrun[/b][/h2][p]Speedrun Mode is now available.[/p][p]No cutscenes, no intermissions, just pure gameplay and a ticking clock. Set your best time and climb the brand-new Speedrun leaderboards. [/p][p][i]Note: Speedrun Mode unlocks after completing the first Story Mode level (The Nest). This is a temporary setup and will be streamlined in the future.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🗺️ [b]Four New Story Mode Levels[/b][/h2][p]We’ve expanded the campaign with one new level per chapter, all fully playable in both Story and Speedrun Modes:[/p][list][*][p]Chapter 1: Dark Waters[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 2: Healthcare Part 2[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 3: Bridge[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 4: Resolution Part 1[/p][/*][/list][p][i]We recommend starting a fresh save file to ensure clean progression with the latest content.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🏆 [b]Bullet Noir is a Collision Awards Finalist[/b][/h2][p]We’re proud to announce that Bullet Noir is a finalist in two categories at the 2025 Collision Awards.[/p][p]You can help us win. Cast your votes here:[/p][p][b] [/b][url="https://vote.collisionawards.com/PublicVoting#/2025/games-xr/best-in-style" style="button"]Vote for Best in Style[/url][b]  [/b][url="https://vote.collisionawards.com/PublicVoting#/2025/games-xr/craft" style="button"]Vote for Best in Craft[/url][/p][p]Thanks for being part of this journey and helping us get here.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]☀️ [b]Steam Summer Sale – 20% Off Until July 10[/b][/h2][p]Bullet Noir is now 20% off as part of the Steam Summer Sale.[/p][p]If you’ve been waiting to dive in, now’s the time.
Experience the new Speedrun Mode, take on fresh levels, and see how far you can climb.[/p][p]We’ve got more updates on the way. Until then, thank you for your support and feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204960/Bullet_Noir/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Update #4 – Patch 0.8.9 is Now Live!

This update brings more slicing, more scoring, and even more ways to rise the leaderboards.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]⚔️ [b]The Lady Joins Arcade Mode[/b][/h2][p]Wield the katana and carve a path through the chaos.
The [b]Lady[/b] is now playable in Arcade Mode. Use her unique skills to cut down enemies in style and chase vengeance your way.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/fe725733cd315761ac3afa7bf0a3799c6df67de5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/5b5fdc3638b10c372b237822460567cc4321eb45.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]📊 [b]Global Leaderboards Now Include Arcade Mode[/b][/h2][p]You asked, we delivered.[/p][list][*][p]Every Arcade Mode level now supports global and friends-only leaderboards[/p][/*][*][p]Compete with any character, on any level[/p][/*][*][p]Show off your high scores and compare your runs with the rest of the world[/p][/*][/list][p]🛈 Note: Arcade Mode levels may have slight differences from their Story Mode versions.
